figurative_meaning_bn: স্থায়ী রঙ যা উঠে যাবে না
figurative_meaning_en: A permanent color that won't fade away
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মনে সেই ঘটনার পাকা রঙ লেগে গেছে।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত পাকা রঙের মতো অপরিবর্তনীয়।
example_sentences_in_english: That incident has left a permanent color in his mind.
This decision is as unchangeable as a fast dye.
note: Refers to dyes in traditional Bengali textiles that do not wash out, symbolizing lasting impressions.
